objective: When the signed-in admin is not email-verified, /invitations shows a confirm-email state instead of a usable invite form.
non_goals: Do not implement real SMTP or the golden-path E2E
Do not invent a second billing model

invariants: Verified admins still list, filter, resend, and cancel invitations
Invite create still posts the same email+role payload when the admin is verified
Existing invitations list and create unit tests stay green for verified users
project.rollback: Revert the xavyo-web PR. Unverified admins see the invite form again; the API gate is unchanged.

notes: No user-only gaps: maturity-plan lot 3 and Auth0 Add Tenant Members require verify-before-invite. JWT has no email_verified claim — GET /me/profile is the source.

Mobbin followed: Air verify banner on the invite surface (a714b643), PayPal amber capability-block banner (61cc199f), PlanetScale confirm card + resend (b118fbad), Loom email chip + resend (c3760374), SchoolAI envelope + sent-to copy (fe1caa40).
Assumed /invitations/create redirects to /invitations when unverified rather than duplicating the card. Fail closed to unverified if profile cannot be loaded.
Pre-mortem: most plausible failure is a verified admin losing Invite user after a profile 500. Fail closed is safer than showing a form the API 403s. Continuity pins verified list/create tests.

risk.rationale: Invite surface is an authz boundary; the page shows the admin email and hides the form until verified.

acceptance.criterion: Unverified admin load of /invitations returns emailVerified false and does not list invitations; create redirects to /invitations.
acceptance.verification: cd /home/ubuntu/xavyo-web && npm run test:unit -- src/routes/(app)/invitations src/lib/server/email-verified.test.ts src/lib/api/auth.test.ts

acceptance.criterion: Verified admins still list invitations and can submit the create form.

execution.rationale: List and create pages share one verification helper and one visual state.

tasks.outcome: Confirm-email state on /invitations; create redirects when unverified.
Unit tests, svelte-autofixer, and live screenshots.
